preregistered_distinction: Whether an index builder authored strictly from rules.md by an uncontaminated implementer reproduces reference.py's output on document.txt (rules.md is silent on the line-number base and on term ordering; the reference numbers lines from 0 and orders terms by first appearance).
rationale: Evidence requirement E-B demands a clean-room implementation comparison; the decision-maker is contaminated by reference.py the moment it observes the package, so the required evidence can only be generated by a fresh isolated descendant.
